text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Against Tama, and against Inari, I 
will...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here comes Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap is 
coming!! Oguri Cap! Oguri Cap takes the 
lead! She crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, that Oguri...! To think she actually 
beat Tama...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Frustrating as it is, Oguri is still 
ahead of me...! I can't let things stay 
like this...!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Just you wait, Oguri. I swear... I'm 
gonna catch up to where you are...!"
